CFML Language Reference: Functions

BitAnd

Returns the bitwise AND of two integers: each bit of the result is 1 only if the same bit is 1 in both arguments. Fractional parts are discarded before the operation.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

BitAnd(number1, number2)

Parameters

number1
An integer.
number2
An integer.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

The usual job of BitAnd is testing flags packed into one number: BitAnd(Flags, 4) NEQ 0 is true when bit 2 is set. To read several adjacent bits at once, BitMaskRead is more readable.

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
